# Module 03. ATAC QC 与综合评级

## Step3. 上游分析 QC 汇总

整合上游 shell 脚本生成的 QC 结果，包括 FRiP 分数、插入片段分布等。

```{r qc_summary, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
# --- 1.1 FRiP 分数汇总 ---
frip_file <- file.path(work_dir, "04counts", "FRiP_scores.txt")
if(file.exists(frip_file)) {
  frip_data <- read.table(frip_file, header=TRUE, sep="\t", stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  frip_data$Group <- sample_group(frip_data$Sample)
  
  p_frip <- ggplot(frip_data, aes(x=Sample, y=FRiP, fill=Group)) +
    geom_bar(stat="identity") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = viz_pal$group) +
    theme_atac_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, hjust=1)) +
    labs(title="Read-level FRiP (alignment overlaps)",
         subtitle="Descriptive QC; no fragment-level acceptance threshold is applied",
         y="Fraction of alignments overlapping peaks", x="Sample")
  
  save_gg_dual(
    p_frip,
    file = step_plot_file("Step3", "FRiP_Scores.pdf"),
    width = 8,
    height = 6
  )
  print(p_frip)
  cat("平均 FRiP:", round(mean(frip_data$FRiP), 3), "\n")
}

# --- 1.2 插入片段长度分布 (ATAC 特异性 QC) ---
insert_size_files <- file.path(work_dir, "02mapping/qc", paste0(samples, ".insert_sizes.txt"))
names(insert_size_files) <- samples

# Process every positive TLEN once in bounded chunks. Histogram plotting does not
# select the beginning of a coordinate-sorted BAM; QC denominators include all sizes.
insert_list <- list()
insert_nfr_summary <- data.frame()
for(s in samples) {
  f <- insert_size_files[s]
  if(!file.exists(f)) next
  con <- file(f, open = "r")
  size_counts <- numeric(1000L)
  total_count <- nfr_count <- mono_count <- 0
  tryCatch({
    repeat {
      sizes <- suppressWarnings(scan(con, what = numeric(), quiet = TRUE, nmax = 1000000L))
      if(length(sizes) == 0L) break
      sizes <- sizes[is.finite(sizes) & sizes > 0]
      total_count <- total_count + length(sizes)
      nfr_count <- nfr_count + sum(sizes < 100)
      mono_count <- mono_count + sum(sizes >= 180 & sizes <= 247)
      size_counts <- size_counts + tabulate(as.integer(sizes[sizes <= 1000]), nbins = 1000L)
    }
  }, finally = close(con))
  insert_nfr_summary <- rbind(insert_nfr_summary, data.frame(
    Sample = s,
    NFR_Ratio = if(total_count > 0) nfr_count / total_count else NA_real_,
    Mono_Ratio = if(total_count > 0) mono_count / total_count else NA_real_,
    FragmentCount = total_count,
    MetricSource = "all positive insert sizes; streaming exact counts; denominator has no upper size truncation",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ))
  insert_list[[s]] <- data.frame(
    Sample = s, Condition = sample_group(s), InsertSize = seq_len(1000L),
    Fraction = if(total_count > 0) size_counts / total_count else NA_real_
  )
}
if(length(insert_list) > 0) {
  insert_df <- do.call(rbind, insert_list)
  p_insert <- ggplot(insert_df, aes(x = InsertSize, y = Fraction, color = Condition,
                                   linetype = Condition, group = Sample)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(50, 200), linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 600)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = viz_pal$group) +
    theme_atac_classic(base_size = 12) +
    labs(title = "ATAC-seq Insert Size Distribution",
         subtitle = "All positive insert sizes; display limited to 0–600 bp",
         x = "Insert Size (bp)", y = "Fraction of all fragments per bp")
  save_gg_dual(p_insert, file = step_plot_file("Step3", "Insert_Size_Distribution.pdf"), width = 10, height = 6)
  print(p_insert)
  nfr_ratio <- stats::setNames(insert_nfr_summary$NFR_Ratio, insert_nfr_summary$Sample)
  write.csv(insert_nfr_summary, step_table_file("Step3", "Insert_Size_NFR_Summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  cat("Nucleosome-free region (<100bp) ratios from all positive insert sizes:\n")
  print(round(nfr_ratio, 3))
}

# --- 1.4 样本测序 QC 与比对有效 reads 汇总 ---
percent_of <- function(num, den) {
  num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(num))
  den <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(den))
  ifelse(!is.na(num) & !is.na(den) & den > 0, 100 * num / den, NA_real_)
}

project_sample_qc <- build_sample_qc_summary(samples) %>%
  mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = group_levels))

sequencing_qc_summary <- project_sample_qc %>%
  transmute(
    Sample,
    Group,
    RawReads = FastpRawReads,
    CleanReads = FastpCleanReads,
    CleanReadsPct = percent_of(FastpCleanReads, FastpRawReads),
    RawBases = FastpRawBases,
    CleanBases = FastpCleanBases,
    CleanBasesPct = percent_of(FastpCleanBases, FastpRawBases),
    Q30RatePct = FastpQ30RatePct,
    GCContentPct = FastpGCContentPct
  )

alignment_effective_reads_summary <- project_sample_qc %>%
  transmute(
    Sample,
    Group,
    TotalCleanReads = FastpCleanReads,
    Bowtie2InputPairs = Bowtie2InputPairs,
    AlignmentRatePct = AlignmentRatePct,
    UniqueMappedPairs = Bowtie2Concordant1Pairs,
    UniqueMappingRatePct = percent_of(Bowtie2Concordant1Pairs, Bowtie2InputPairs),
    MappedQ30Reads = MappedQ30Reads,
    NonMitoProperPairReads = FilteredNonMitoProperPairReads,
    EffectiveReads = FinalDedupReads,
    EffectiveRatePct = percent_of(FinalDedupReads, FastpCleanReads),
    DupRatePct = DupRatePct,
    MitoPct = MitoPct,
    FRiP = FRiP,
    FRiPPct = 100 * FRiP
  )

write.csv(sequencing_qc_summary, step_table_file("Step3", "Sequencing_QC_Summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(alignment_effective_reads_summary, step_table_file("Step3", "Alignment_Effective_Reads_Summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

sequencing_qc_plot_df <- sequencing_qc_summary %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(CleanReadsPct, CleanBasesPct, Q30RatePct, GCContentPct),
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  )

p_sequencing_qc <- ggplot(sequencing_qc_plot_df, aes(x = Sample, y = Value, fill = Group)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72) +
  facet_wrap(~Metric, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +

alignment_qc_plot_df <- alignment_effective_reads_summary %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(AlignmentRatePct, UniqueMappingRatePct, EffectiveRatePct, DupRatePct, MitoPct, FRiPPct),
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  )

p_alignment_qc <- ggplot(alignment_qc_plot_df, aes(x = Sample, y = Value, fill = Group)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72) +
  facet_wrap(~Metric, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = viz_pal$group, drop = FALSE) +
  theme_atac_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +

if(emit_light_plots) {
  save_plot_pdf(p_sequencing_qc, step_plot_file("Step3", "Sequencing_QC_Metrics.pdf"), width = 12, height = 8)
  save_plot_pdf(p_alignment_qc, step_plot_file("Step3", "Alignment_Effective_Reads_Metrics.pdf"), width = 14, height = 8)
  print(p_sequencing_qc)

}
```

## Step3. 综合 QC 评估与证据分级

将上游流程生成的对齐、线粒体比例、重复率、FRiP、peak 数量和 TSS enrichment 统一汇总，形成适合汇报的样本级 QC 结果。

```{r integrated_qc_summary, fig.width=14, fig.height=8}
read_upstream_tsv <- function(path) {
  if(file.exists(path)) {
    read.delim(path, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
  } else {
    data.frame()
  }
}

library_complexity_tbl <- read_upstream_tsv(file.path(work_dir, "06qc_report", "Library_Complexity_Metrics.tsv"))
fragment_class_tbl <- read_upstream_tsv(file.path(work_dir, "06qc_report", "Fragment_Size_Classes.tsv"))
tss_method_tbl <- read_upstream_tsv(file.path(work_dir, "06qc_report", "TSS_Enrichment_Method.tsv"))
optional_tool_tbl <- read_upstream_tsv(file.path(work_dir, "06qc_report", "Optional_Tool_Status.tsv"))
software_versions_tbl <- read_upstream_tsv(file.path(work_dir, "06qc_report", "software_versions.tsv"))
ataqv_status_tbl <- read_upstream_tsv(file.path(work_dir, "06qc_report", "ataqv", "Ataqv_QC_Status.tsv"))
ataqv_metrics_long_tbl <- read_upstream_tsv(file.path(work_dir, "06qc_report", "Ataqv_QC_Metrics_Long.tsv"))
if(!"Sample" %in% colnames(library_complexity_tbl)) library_complexity_tbl <- data.frame(Sample = character())

fragment_summary_tbl <- if(nrow(fragment_class_tbl) > 0 && all(c("Sample", "Class", "Fraction", "FragmentCount") %in% colnames(fragment_class_tbl))) {
  fragment_wide <- fragment_class_tbl %>%
    dplyr::select(Sample, Class, Fraction, FragmentCount) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = Class,
      values_from = c(Fraction, FragmentCount),
      names_sep = "_"
    )
  if(!"Fraction_NFR_lt100bp" %in% colnames(fragment_wide)) fragment_wide$Fraction_NFR_lt100bp <- NA_real_
  if(!"Fraction_Mononucleosome_180_247bp" %in% colnames(fragment_wide)) fragment_wide$Fraction_Mononucleosome_180_247bp <- NA_real_
  colnames(fragment_wide)[colnames(fragment_wide) == "Fraction_NFR_lt100bp"] <- "NFRFraction"
  colnames(fragment_wide)[colnames(fragment_wide) == "Fraction_Mononucleosome_180_247bp"] <- "MononucleosomeFraction"
  fragment_wide
} else {
  data.frame(Sample = character())
}

sample_qc <- build_sample_qc_summary(samples) %>%
  left_join(library_complexity_tbl, by = "Sample") %>%
  left_join(fragment_summary_tbl, by = "Sample") %>%
  mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = group_levels))
for(qc_col in c("NRF", "PBC1", "PBC2", "NFRFraction", "MononucleosomeFraction")) {
  if(!qc_col %in% colnames(sample_qc)) sample_qc[[qc_col]] <- NA_real_
}

write.csv(sample_qc, step_table_file("Step3", "QC_Sample_Summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
if(nrow(fragment_class_tbl) > 0) write.csv(fragment_class_tbl, step_table_file("Step3", "Fragment_Size_Classes.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
if(nrow(library_complexity_tbl) > 0) write.csv(library_complexity_tbl, step_table_file("Step3", "Library_Complexity_Metrics.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
if(nrow(tss_method_tbl) > 0) write.csv(tss_method_tbl, step_table_file("Step3", "TSS_Enrichment_Method.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
if(nrow(optional_tool_tbl) > 0) write.csv(optional_tool_tbl, step_table_file("Step3", "Optional_Tool_Status.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
if(nrow(software_versions_tbl) > 0) write.csv(software_versions_tbl, step_table_file("Step3", "Software_Versions.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
if(nrow(ataqv_status_tbl) > 0) write.csv(ataqv_status_tbl, step_table_file("Step3", "Ataqv_QC_Status.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
if(nrow(ataqv_metrics_long_tbl) > 0) write.csv(ataqv_metrics_long_tbl, step_table_file("Step3", "Ataqv_QC_Metrics_Long.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

    "PCR bottlenecking coefficient 2: singleton fragment positions / duplicated-twice fragment positions",
    "Fraction of fragments shorter than 100 bp, expected to capture nucleosome-free ATAC fragments",

    "FilteredNonMitoProperPairReads",
    "NA",
    "FRiPTotalReads / FinalDedupReads",

    "DistinctFragments",

    "Flanking TSS signal"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write.csv(qc_metric_definitions, step_table_file("Step3", "QC_Metric_Definitions.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

parse_idr_log <- function(log_file) {
  if(!file.exists(log_file)) {
    return(data.frame(
      IDRReportedPeaks = NA_real_,
      IDRPassPeaks = NA_real_,
      IDRPassRatePct = NA_real_
    ))
  }
  lines <- readLines(log_file, warn = FALSE)
  reported <- grep("Number of reported peaks", lines, value = TRUE)
  passed <- grep("Number of peaks passing IDR cutoff", lines, value = TRUE)
  data.frame(
    IDRReportedPeaks = ifelse(length(reported) > 0, as.numeric(gsub(".*- ([0-9]+)\\/.*", "\\1", reported[1])), NA_real_),
    IDRPassPeaks = ifelse(length(passed) > 0, as.numeric(gsub(".*- ([0-9]+)\\/.*", "\\1", passed[1])), NA_real_),
    IDRPassRatePct = ifelse(length(passed) > 0, as.numeric(gsub(".*\\(([0-9.]+)%\\).*", "\\1", passed[1])), NA_real_)
  )
}

group_qc <- sample_qc %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarise(
    SampleCount = n(),
    Mean_FastpRawReads = mean(FastpRawReads, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_FastpCleanReads = mean(FastpCleanReads, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_FastpSurvivalPct = mean(FastpSurvivalPct, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Bowtie2InputPairs = mean(Bowtie2InputPairs, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_MappedQ30Reads = mean(MappedQ30Reads, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_FilteredNonMitoProperPairReads = mean(FilteredNonMitoProperPairReads, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_FinalDedupReads = mean(FinalDedupReads, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_AlignmentRatePct = mean(AlignmentRatePct, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_MitoPct = mean(MitoPct, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_DupRatePct = mean(DupRatePct, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_ReadsInPeaks = mean(ReadsInPeaks, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_FRiP = mean(FRiP, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_NRF = mean(NRF, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_PBC1 = mean(PBC1, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_PBC2 = mean(PBC2, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_NFRFraction = mean(NFRFraction, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_MononucleosomeFraction = mean(MononucleosomeFraction, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_CleanPeakCount = mean(CleanPeakCount, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_ApproxTSSEnrichment = mean(ApproxTSSEnrichment, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

idr_group_qc <- read_upstream_tsv(file.path(work_dir, "03peaks", "IDR_Reproducibility_Summary.tsv"))
if(nrow(idr_group_qc) == 0) {
  idr_group_qc <- bind_rows(lapply(group_levels, function(group_name) {
    safe_group <- gsub("[^[:alnum:]_.-]", "_", group_name)
    cbind(Group = group_name, parse_idr_log(file.path("03peaks", paste0(safe_group, "_true_replicates_IDR.log"))))
  }))
}

group_qc <- left_join(group_qc, idr_group_qc, by = "Group")
write.csv(group_qc, step_table_file("Step3", "QC_Group_Summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

threshold_df <- bind_rows(
  sample_qc %>% transmute(Sample, Group, Metric = "AlignmentRatePct", Value = AlignmentRatePct, Threshold = ">=90", Status = qc_status(AlignmentRatePct, 90, "ge")),
  sample_qc %>% transmute(Sample, Group, Metric = "MitoPct", Value = MitoPct, Threshold = "<=20", Status = qc_status(MitoPct, 20, "le")),
  sample_qc %>% transmute(Sample, Group, Metric = "DupRatePct", Value = DupRatePct, Threshold = "<=50", Status = qc_status(DupRatePct, 50, "le")),
  sample_qc %>% transmute(Sample, Group, Metric = "NRF", Value = NRF, Threshold = ">=0.8 preferred", Status = qc_status(NRF, 0.8, "ge")),
  sample_qc %>% transmute(Sample, Group, Metric = "PBC1", Value = PBC1, Threshold = ">=0.9 preferred", Status = qc_status(PBC1, 0.9, "ge")),
  sample_qc %>% transmute(Sample, Group, Metric = "PBC2", Value = PBC2, Threshold = ">=1 acceptable; >3 ideal", Status = qc_status(PBC2, 1, "ge")),
  sample_qc %>% transmute(Sample, Group, Metric = "CleanPeakCount", Value = CleanPeakCount, Threshold = ">=30000", Status = qc_status(CleanPeakCount, 30000, "ge"))
)
write.csv(threshold_df, step_table_file("Step3", "QC_Threshold_Assessment.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

frip_informational_tbl <- sample_qc %>%
  transmute(Sample, Group, Metric = "ReadLevel_FRiP", Value = FRiP,

write.csv(frip_informational_tbl, step_table_file("Step3", "FRiP_Informational_Metrics.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

            AssessmentRole = "INFORMATIONAL_ONLY; not included in hard QC assessment")
write.csv(tss_informational_tbl, step_table_file("Step3", "TSS_Informational_Metrics.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

p_qc_overview <- sample_qc %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, Group, FastpSurvivalPct, AlignmentRatePct, MitoPct, DupRatePct, FRiP, NRF, PBC1, PBC2, NFRFraction, MononucleosomeFraction, ApproxTSSEnrichment, CleanPeakCount) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(FastpSurvivalPct, AlignmentRatePct, MitoPct, DupRatePct, FRiP, NRF, PBC1, PBC2, NFRFraction, MononucleosomeFraction, ApproxTSSEnrichment, CleanPeakCount),

}
```
